verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents an Automation API that exposes the engine as an SDK, so software can create, update, configure and destroy infrastructure without the CLI. A community user independently praises the feature, and the docs also reference calling the Pulumi Cloud REST API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and in-depth evidence of the Pulumi Cloud REST API docs beyond a page title.
